name: Provinces of Belgium
author: Addicting Games
description: Provinces of Belgium is a geography game that teaches you about the provinces of Belgium. There are not a lot of places that still have a monarchy but Belgium is one of them. If you are thinking of visiting this beautiful country to get a glimpse of their royalty then you should probably get to know the area. There are 11 provinces in Belgium and with the help of this map game, you will memorize them in no time. Do you know where East Flanders, Liege, and Luxembourg are? If not, then do not sweat it. You will learn these 3 provinces and the others with this geography game. This online game is designed to teach you as you go while being fun and easy to understand. Just click on the country, and the game will let you know if you got it right or wrong. Along the way, you will learn where the provinces are. With education, repetition is key and this map game can be played, over and over again, until you are an expert.
